Five Desks v5 collapse test (positive control)

rca-umb/five-desks-control

Complete eight-domain tool tasks, where the reward only pays for ending the episode as early as possible, as a diagnostic of the arena.

  • checking whether training moves the private score

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Ignores the answer; pays 1.0 when the first call ends the episode, falling linearly to 0 as the tool budget runs out.
